quality.rationale: Open P2 backlog and expanded hosted font options are implemented and verified with automated tests, production build, and headless Chromium runtime gate. Coverage includes exactly 20 bundled default templates with five per category, template metadata, always-visible guided start, preview-pane edit state, Colors-to-Brand-kit registration, service-section removal, expanded Google Fonts dropdown choices, brand kit helpers, quality warning helpers, edit-state JSON recovery helpers, CSV/HTML persistence, inspector editing, WebP export, mobile no-overflow, user-facing docs, and QCDS evidence. Cross-browser and real-device edge cases remain future work.

cost.rationale: Static browser-only GitHub Pages app with no backend, no paid service dependency, browser-local edit state, template, color, saved palette, and custom font storage, and client-side YouTube thumbnail import.

delivery.rationale: TODO and local Issues are closed, implementation and docs are aligned, README, user guide, and screenshot guide are present, QCDS evidence is recorded, tests/build/runtime gate pass, and docs packaging remains available through the existing workflow. A fresh remote Pages run after this commit remains pending until pushed.

satisfaction.rationale: Requested P2 backlog and expanded font selection passed validation: 20 practical bundled templates with five per category, always-visible guided start, preview-pane edit state, Colors-to-Brand-kit registration, Templates service-section removal, and 26 text-layer font dropdown options. Issue 0064 adds a screenshot-based guide, and Issues 0065-0068 add beginner guided creation, template filters/previews, creator brand reuse, quality warnings, state JSON recovery, and in-app issue/privacy display through the header and preview storage note. CSV/HTML import/export persistence works, WebP export works, and QCDS evidence is updated. Remaining satisfaction risk is broader real-user font files, real-device checks, and non-Chromium browser coverage.
